name: homerail-miko-macos
description: HomeRail Miko always-on macOS voice assistant shell.

scripts.test: npm run build && node --test dist/settings-store.test.js dist/diagnostic-log.test.js dist/kws/*.test.js
scripts.build:source: npm --prefix ../homerail_protocol run build && npm --prefix ../homerail_plugin_sdk run build && npm --prefix ../homerail_manager run build && npm --prefix ../homerail_node run build && npm --prefix ../homerail_worker run build && npm --prefix ../homerail_cli run build && npm --prefix ../agent-ui run build
scripts.dist: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml
scripts.dist:ci: npm run prepare:runtime && npm run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.yml --publish never
